originalAlarm.description: The value written to `&argv` is never used.

reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE: The alarm reports the incremented value of 'argv' (from 'p = *argv++, --argc' at line 16) as a dead store — after the post-increment, argv is never used again in the simplified function. In the real BusyBox hdparm main(), argv would be used to continue parsing command-line arguments after the switch statement. The simplified file stripped all subsequent uses. This is a simplification artifact. The known vbdb bug for 061fd0a353e.c is UndefinedSymbol: 'goto expected_hwif_error' at line 21 (inside #ifdef HDIO_UNREGISTER_HWIF) jumps to a label that is only defined inside #ifdef HDIO_SCAN_HWIF — so when UNREGISTER_HWIF=true but SCAN_HWIF=false, the label is undefined. The presence condition requires both flags true, so the known bug is not triggered in this configuration.
